selection_rationale: Baseline achieved holdout weighted RMSE 2.1026; the fully-specified advanced model (regularised spline + iterative robust reweighting) could not beat it on this dataset (best 2.2159 at lambda=1e+07 across the searched grid). The iterative robust reweighting downweights a meaningful share of bonds whose larger-but-genuine dispersion is not actually noise, which slightly hurts generalisation here. Complexity is not rewarded on this dataset, so the simpler baseline is selected for the delivered curve.
